messages:
maria_pm: Heads-up: Nova asked for a Private pilot agreement draft. Must include explicit compatibility commitments, a pre-warm + failover playbook, and acceptance criteria before they sign. Main constraints: tenant isolation, customer-managed KMS, and a 200-300ms p95 latency window for interactive flows.
aj_runtime: Clarify latency window: is p95 200 or 300ms? Also need to know allowed quality degradation when failing over to quantized stacks.
maria_pm: Product is asking for <=250ms p95 for short prompts (<=256 tokens). They expect graceful quality degradation, not silent hallucination regressions.
sam_infra: Capacity note: Dedicated can provide 3 steady GPU slots and 2 burst slots for the pilot if committed 4 weeks out. Prewarm/soak needs 7 days. We'll need a firm sign-off to hit dates.
lucy_sec: Security gating: HSM-backed keys with attestation report, proof-of-forwarding to customer SIEM, and no snapshots containing plaintext key material. Also require mTLS between customer ingress and our edge (mutual auth).
dylan_eng: Integration plan from app side: feature-flagged rollout, canary at 5% for first 24h, automated rollback hook, and blackbox quality checks. I'll provide a smoke test script and a `rollback.sh` entry.
aj_runtime: Runtime commitments we can give: support for fp16 and q4_0 quant variants for the pilot, automatic fallback to q4_0 when p99 crosses threshold, and KV-prefix caching enabled. int8/q2 variants need additional validation so mark as not-supported for pilot.
maria_pm: Acceptance criteria draft (to be finalized):
- latency: <=250ms p95 for <=256 token traces under expected load
- isolation: tenant-dedicated compute + segregated logs (no cross-tenant indices)
- keys: customer KMS/HSM used for tenant encryption, attestation report provided
- reliability: documented failover with recovery-time-objective <=5 minutes for control-plane reroute
- quality: similarity metric (embedding cosine) degradation < 0.05 vs baseline across smoke prompts
aj_runtime: Draft routing/fallback config below (for review):
```yaml
routing:
  priority: latency
  canary_fraction: 0.05
  fallback:
    trigger: p99_latency > 1200ms
    model: model-q4_0
    preserve_kv_cache: true
  prewarm: true
```
sam_infra: Loadtest ask: 48h sustained soak at 1.5x expected traffic, plus a ramp to spike at 3x for 30m. We'll schedule once infra commit is signed.
lucy_sec: Add-on: we require an automated test that proves mTLS termination is mutual (client cert validation) and that HSM keys are never exported in request logs. Also request a short attestation checklist we can hand the customer.
dylan_eng: I'll add the following to CI smoke: quality checks (BLEU-like for structured tasks), latency markers, and a regression alert webhook. Also will include runbook steps for toggling the fallback and for draining canary traffic.
maria_pm: Owners & short due dates:
- aj_runtime -> compatibility matrix + routing config (Due: Tue)
- sam_infra -> capacity commit + prewarm schedule (Due: Wed)
- lucy_sec -> attestation checklist + gating doc (Due: Wed)
- dylan_eng -> smoke tests + rollback scripts (Due: Thu)
- maria_pm -> finalize pilot acceptance doc and send to Nova (Due: Fri)
ops-bot: INF-4399 created: "nova-pilot-onboarding-playbook" and prewarm job scheduled for 2024-05-12 03:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
lucy_sec: small nuance: customer-managed KMS integration requires proof that key IDs are never logged; add that to gating.
aj_runtime: Good catch. We'll include log-scrubbing verification and a small integration test that checks log artifacts after a synthetic run.
maria_pm: Timeline alignment: if we hit owners' due dates this week, we can offer Nova a pilot window starting 2024-05-20 with a 2-week pilot. Confirm by EOD tomorrow if possible.
sam_infra: Confirmed tentative hold on capacity; will convert to reservation once product sign-off and PO are in.
dylan_eng: Will push PRs for smoke/rollback today and link in the checklist.
maria_pm: OK reconvene Fri 11:00am PT to sign off on artifacts before sending to customer. Thanks team :rocket:
